text: These walls defend the house from the wind.
translation: 这些墙保护房子不受风吹。
note: defend A from B = 防护

text: He put on warm clothes to defend himself against the cold.
A good coat will defend you from the rain.
translation: 一件好外套能让你免受雨淋。

text: The trees defend the soil from being washed away.
translation: 这些树保护土壤不被冲走。

text: She defended her idea to the whole class.
translation: 她向全班为自己的想法辩护。

text: He spoke up to defend his old teacher.
translation: 他出面为他的老老师辩护。

text: Nobody can defend such a terrible decision.
translation: 没人能为这样糟糕的决定辩护。

text: My friends defended me when others blamed me.
translation: 别人怪我时，朋友们为我辩护。
note: stand up to defend = 辩护

text: A small band of soldiers defended the bridge.
translation: 一小队士兵防卫了这座桥。

text: They fought all night to defend their own land.
translation: 他们战斗了一整夜保卫自己的土地。

text: The soldiers were ordered to defend the gate.
translation: 士兵们奉命保卫这道门。
note: 军事上的防卫 = 防卫

text: He stayed to defend the shop from thieves.
translation: 他留下来防卫商店免遭窃贼。
note: 防卫具体目标 = 防卫

text: This fence defends the garden from the sheep.
translation: 这道篱笆保护花园不让羊进来。

text: He could not defend himself against such facts.
translation: 他无法为自己抵挡这样的事实。

text: Only ten soldiers defended the small town.
translation: 只有十名士兵防卫这座小城。
